The hypothalamus releases CRF (corticotropin-releasing factor), which stimulates the pituitary to release ACTH, which then stimulates the adrenal cortex to release cortisol.  
Cortisol, once elevated, exerts negative feedback on both the hypothalamus and the pituitary to reduce further CRF and ACTH release, thereby suppressing the initial trigger.  

This matches option (C).  

Final answer: (C)
